description_en: Queries the policy-based route rules in the policy route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器策略路由表中的策略路由规则信息
name: DescribeTransitRouterPolicyBasedRoutes

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the policy routing table
parameters.name: policy_table_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.
If NextToken returns a value, the value is the token used to start the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. Valid values:

PolicyBasedRouteId: the instance ID of the policy-based routing rule.

By default, multiple filter conditions are evaluated by using the AND operator. A resource matches the filter only if it meets all the specified conditions.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件。取值：

PolicyBasedRouteId：策略路由规则实例ID。

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition.

Specify the filter value based on the Key. You can specify multiple values for a single Key. Multiple values are evaluated by using the OR operator. A resource matches the filter condition if it meets at least one of the specified values.

You can specify up to 5 values for each filter condition
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。

根据Key指定过滤值。一个Key支持指定多个过滤值，多个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件。

一个过滤条件最多支持输入5个过滤值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件的信息。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

AddressFamily.description_en:
The address family. Valid values:

IPv4
IPv6
AddressFamily.description_zh:
地址族。可能值：

IPv4。
IPv6

Description.description_en: The description of the policy route table instance
Description.description_zh: 策略路由表实例的描述信息

DestPortRange.description_en:
The destination port. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Matches traffic whose port number falls within the destination port range. If this parameter is not specified, traffic to any destination port is matched.

The port range format is described as follows:

80: specifies port 80.
80/80: specifies port 80.
1/200: specifies ports 1 to 200.
-1/-1: specifies all ports
DestPortRange.description_zh:
目的端口。取值范围：-1或1~65535。

匹配端口号在目的端口范围中的流量，如果不设置则代表匹配任意目的端口号的流量。

端口范围格式说明如下：

80，表示端口80。
80/80，表示端口80。
1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
-1/-1，表示匹配任意端口

Dscp.description_en:
The Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value of the traffic packets to match. Valid values: 0 to 63.

The input format is described as follows:

1: matches traffic with a DSCP value of 1.
1/10: matches traffic with a DSCP value from 1 to 10.
-1/-1: matches traffic with any DSCP value
Dscp.description_zh:
匹配流量报文的DSCP（Differentiated Services Code Point）值。取值范围：0~63。

端口范围输入格式说明如下：

1，表示匹配dscp为1的流量。
1/10，表示匹配dscp1至10的流量。
-1/-1，表示匹配任意dscp的流量

Name.description_en:
The name of the policy-based route rule.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
Name.description_zh:
策略路由规则的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头

PolicyBasedRouteId.description_en: The instance ID of the policy-based routing rule

PolicyTableId.description_en: The instance ID of the policy routing table

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the policy-based route. Valid values: 1 to 100.

The priority of each policy-based route in a transit router policy route table must be unique. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh:
策略路由的优先级。取值范围：1~100。

一个转发路由器策略路由表实例下，每个策略路由的优先级需保证唯一。数字越小，优先级越高

Protocol.description_en:
The protocol type of the traffic packets.

Traffic classification rules support matching traffic of various protocol types, such as HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, SSH, and Telnet. For more protocol types, log on to the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) console (https://cen.console.aliyun.com/cen/list)
Protocol.description_zh:
流量报文的协议类型。

流分类规则支持匹配HTTP、HTTPS、TCP、UDP、SSH、Telnet等多种协议类型的流量。更多协议类型，请登录云企业网管理控制台 (https://cen.console.aliyun.com/cen/list)查看

SourcePortRange.description_en:
The source port. Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

Matches traffic whose port number falls within the source port range. If this parameter is not specified, traffic from any source port is matched.

The port range format is described as follows:

80: specifies port 80.
80/80: specifies port 80.
1/200: specifies ports 1 to 200.
-1/-1: specifies all ports
SourcePortRange.description_zh:
源端口。取值范围：-1或1~65535。

匹配端口号在源端口范围中的流量，如果不设置则代表匹配任意源端口号的流量。

端口范围格式说明如下：

80，表示端口80。
80/80，表示端口80。
1/200，表示端口范围1至200。
-1/-1，表示匹配任意端口

Status.description_en:
The status of the policy-based route. Valid values:

Creating: creating
Active: available
Deleting: deleting
Status.description_zh:
策略路由的状态。

Creating：创建中。
Active：可用。
Deleting：删除中
